Name: Handling proof
Deliverables: One car; one track; Android touch controls; active sliding; restart; replay-format spike; high-oblique 3D camera calibration
Exit gate: 10 external testers; 7 voluntarily retry at least 5 times; no critical input fault; owner approves handling; 1.15x scene framing accepted

Name: Cel-shaded 3D visual slice
Deliverables: One polished car/corner; material library; overhead camera; race HUD; garage view; Compatibility/Mobile comparison
Exit gate: Owner approves on phone; reference proportions match; full-lap visibility and frame-time/thermal test; re-estimate full art scope

Name: Complete offline race loop
Deliverables: Timing/checkpoints; 3–5 laps; ghosts; results; local saves; 6 tracks
Exit gate: Save survives force-stop; race timing and cuts tested; offline progression journal reliable

Name: Garage and rewards
Deliverables: 3 car archetypes; earned parts; tuning; credits/XP; economy simulator
Exit gate: No payment path to performance; normal play always earns; farm tests and 10-hour progression playthrough

Name: Track creation and private sharing
Deliverables: Constrained editor; validate/test; versioning; import/export; immutable challenge package
Exit gate: 8 of 10 novices create/play/share a valid track without help in 5 minutes

Name: Online times and trust
Deliverables: Accounts; backend; verification worker; cloud ledger; shared tracks; histograms/neighbours
Exit gate: Cross-device replay test passes; duplicate writes safe; no client write access to balances or verified times

Name: League loop
Deliverables: Weekly cohorts; 3 fixed events; class/spec rules; seasons; fair rewards; low-population fallback
Exit gate: Two complete test seasons settle exactly once; no rewards for grinding rank; no fake human entrants

Name: Commerce and public-service readiness
Deliverables: Creator entitlements; cosmetics; moderation/admin; privacy/deletion; recovery; store assets
Exit gate: Test purchases/refunds restore correctly; reporting staffed; deletion and backup restore rehearsed

Name: Measured soft launch
Deliverables: Closed test; recruitment; performance/retention analysis; economy adjustments; staged rollout
Exit gate: No severe integrity/save/commerce defects; predefined data gate reviewed; owner approves budget
